## Checks

- [ ] `uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `uv run pyright -p .`
- [ ] `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 uv run pytest -q -n auto` (or the packages this touches: name them)
- [ ] `results/` is unchanged, or every change is regenerated by its script and explained in a new
      `docs/design-log.md` entry
- [ ] `uv run python scripts/site_data.py --check` and, if a chart moved, `cd site && npm run charts` (SVGs committed)
- [ ] Specs or tasks changed: `uv run python scripts/build_specs.py --check` and the shortcut matrix row
- [ ] Site or console changed: the `site` or `helpdesk-ui` job's commands from `.github/workflows/ci.yml`
- [ ] A line under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`, if users would notice the change
- [ ] Version or metadata changed: `uv run python scripts/check_metadata.py`

## Clean room

- [ ] This contains no third-party proprietary code or data, no non-public task content, and no secrets.
